_readme: WhatsApp message templates for the Thapsus Cargo flow — upload/create these in the sent.dm console (channel: whatsapp, language: en). Variable names match exactly what the app sends as template parameters; samples are included for Meta review. After approval, map them in /ops/settings → 'sent.dm template map' using the key → name pairs shown in _template_map_after_approval.

body.template:
Karibu Thapsus Cargo.

We buy items from online stores abroad and deliver them to your door in Kenya. How it works:
1. Send us the product link(s)
2. We reply with a KES quote
3. Pay via M-Pesa
4. We buy & ship it — you track it with your code until it's delivered

First, let's set you up. What's your full name?

You're all set. Your customer code is *{{customer_code}}* — keep it handy, it goes on all your parcels.

Send us a product link any time and we'll get you a quote.

*Your quote is ready*

Item price: ${{usd_price}}
Exchange rate: 1 USD = {{fx_rate}} KES
Service margin: {{markup_pct}}%
*Total: KSh {{total_kes}}*

Reply *YES* to confirm and we'll send the M-Pesa payment prompt.

Great! Your order is confirmed at *KSh {{amount_kes}}*.

To pay: Lipa na M-Pesa → Buy Goods → Till *5530500* → KSh {{amount_kes}}.

Reply here once you've paid and we'll confirm it right away.

Asante. We've got your payment notification ({{reference}}) and our team is verifying it with M-Pesa now.

We'll confirm here as soon as it clears and send your tracking code — usually within a few minutes.

Payment received — asante.

Your tracking code is *{{tracking_code}}*. Text it to us any time to check on your parcel.

We're purchasing your item now and will keep you posted.

Here's your receipt for {{tracking_code}}: {{receipt_url}}

Keep it for your records — and remember you can text your tracking code any time for a status update.

Your item has been purchased and is on its way to our facility.

Track it anytime by sending your code *{{tracking_code}}*.

*{{tracking_code}}* has arrived in Kenya.

Last step: a delivery fee of *KSh {{fee_kes}}* gets it to your door. We'll send an M-Pesa prompt — or reply here if you have any questions.

*{{tracking_code}}* has arrived in Kenya.

Good news — your delivery fee is on us. We'll dispatch it to your address shortly.

*{{tracking_code}}* is out for delivery to your address.

Expect it within 24 hours. Our rider will call you on arrival.

*{{tracking_code}}* has been delivered — asante for shopping with Thapsus Cargo.

Send us another link any time.
